introHtml: Carabiner badge reels offer a secure way to attach IDs to belt loops or bags, reducing the risk of lost badges in busy environments. The built-in carabiner clip provides quick attachment and removal, ideal for facilities staff, warehouse teams, or outdoor events. Choose from metal or plastic carabiners and customize with your logo using pad printing or full-color imprinting. These reels combine durability with easy access for daily use.
heroAltText: Custom with carabiner badge reels featuring a retractable cord and metal carabiner clip for secure badge attachment.
